xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-5061: Per-project MCP servers and credentials for agents

plan.title: Per-project MCP servers and credentials for agents
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

metadata.sizeJustification: 27 files_scope paths across 6 subsystems. The opt-in isolation third of the issue is already split out (PAN-5065). What remains is coupled: project MCP server headers/env must interpolate project secrets (the two-Linear-accounts motivation), so the secrets resolver and the MCP render share one launch-project resolver. Eight of the files are one-line in-place call-site threadings (WI-7) and two are leaf docs; splitting further would ship either MCP servers that cannot carry per-project tokens or secrets with no MCP consumer.

narratives.Problem: Every agent in every project gets the same ~/.overdeck.env credentials and the same MCP servers (role frontmatter plus the operator's user-scope Claude servers). There is no per-project MCP setting, workspace.env.secrets_file is declared but never read, and two accounts on one service (two Linear workspaces) cannot be told apart.
narratives.Proposal: Add projects.<key>.mcp_servers (role mcpServers: shape, stdio or http) and mcp_strict, resolved per launch (issue prefix, then cwd) with ${NAME} expansion from the project's secrets_file then process.env. Render them into the existing per-agent launch MCP file for Claude Code and ACP (decoupled from the overdeck token gate), into codex-home config.toml for Codex (http via url + http_headers), and warn for harnesses without MCP. Implement workspace.env.secrets_file: values merged into the pane env at the single launchAgentPane chokepoint and into that project's host-run quality gate env. Document in configuration/mcp.mdx, configuration/projects.mdx and docs/ROLES.md.
narratives.NonGoals:
- Opt-in credential isolation / blanking ~/.overdeck.env keys (PAN-5065)
- Applying skill-pack .mcp.json files through project mcp_servers
- Project MCP servers or secrets for remote (Fly) workspaces or inside Docker containers (container gates get them only on the docker exec client)
- MCP support for ohmypi, kimi-code, muse or prime-agent (warning only)
- Role MCP servers for ACP harnesses
- Interactive OAuth for HTTP MCP servers inside a spawned agent
- Dashboard UI for editing mcp_servers or secrets_file
- Changing how ~/.overdeck.env itself is loaded by the dashboard or pan CLI
- Deleting the launch MCP file when an agent stops
- Accepting mcp_servers as a plain map (only the role list-of-single-key-maps shape)
- Growing any god file (projects.ts, spawn.ts, conversation-runtime.ts) or raising scripts/file-size-allowlist.txt

autoDecisions.summary: Split opt-in credential isolation into sibling issue PAN-5065
autoDecisions.rationale: Probes showed the pane env is not the main leak path on the default Herdr backend (pan CLI loader, direct file readers, non-systemd servers and gates are), so isolation is a separate design; the remaining MCP + secrets work still exceeds the size lint and isolation is the cleanly separable third.

autoDecisions.summary: Project servers share the per-agent overdeck-mcp.json launch file instead of a second --mcp-config
autoDecisions.rationale: The ACP host reads exactly one --mcp-config file, so one file gives Claude and ACP the same servers with no ACP change.

autoDecisions.summary: Write the launch MCP file even when mcp.agents is false or the token mint fails
autoDecisions.rationale: Project servers are operator config independent of the overdeck server toggle.

autoDecisions.summary: A role MCP server wins a name clash with a project server; 'overdeck' is reserved
autoDecisions.rationale: Roles declare the tools their job needs (test role -> playwright); a project must not silently replace them.

autoDecisions.summary: Overdeck resolves ${NAME} at launch and writes literal values into 0600 files
autoDecisions.rationale: Claude, Codex and ACP expand differently; one Overdeck rule gives identical behavior everywhere and keeps values out of projects.yaml.

autoDecisions.summary: Launch project resolves by issue prefix first, then cwd containment
autoDecisions.rationale: Issue prefix is exact; cwd covers conversations and issue-less runs; unregistered dirs get nothing, the safe default.

autoDecisions.summary: Inject secrets at launchAgentPane and resolve gate secrets inside runQualityGates
autoDecisions.rationale: Both are single chokepoints, covering every launch path and both gate callers without touching god files like merge-ops.ts.

autoDecisions.summary: Quality gates receive project secrets (gate.env still wins); remote gates do not
autoDecisions.rationale: Gates already see every ~/.overdeck.env key; moving a key into a project secrets file must not break that project's gates.

Probe proved strict keeps every --mcp-config file and drops user-scope servers; it is the only way to meet the issue's context-cost motivation, and off by default to avoid breaking operators who rely on user servers.

autoDecisions.summary: Codex renders http project servers as url + http_headers
autoDecisions.rationale: Codex CLI 0.159.0 probe parsed http_headers as streamable_http transport headers.

autoDecisions.summary: secrets_file must be an absolute or ~/ path outside the project path; OVERDECK_* and provider keys are dropped
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue specifies a file outside the repo; reserved keys belong to Overdeck's model routing and launch identity.
